name: raidcom-mcp
description: Community MCP server that builds and validates Hitachi raidcom commands and scripts from plain-language requests. Build-only.
long_description: Turns a storage task into validated raidcom commands and scripts: it finds the right command, checks every option against the manual's syntax and the storage model's limits, and returns text for you to review and run on a host with CCI installed. It never connects to a storage system and needs no credentials or settings. This is a community project, not an official Hitachi Vantara product.

tools.name: raidcom_list_commands
tools.description: Find raidcom commands from a question in plain words.

tools.name: raidcom_describe_command
tools.description: Show a command's syntax forms, options and examples.

tools.name: raidcom_build_command
tools.description: Build and validate one raidcom command.

tools.name: raidcom_check_command
tools.description: Check and explain an existing raidcom command line.

tools.name: raidcom_build_script
tools.description: Build a validated shell script from steps, with ranges.

tools.name: raidcom_list_recipes
tools.description: List ready-made workflows such as provisioning and pool creation.

tools.name: raidcom_build_recipe
tools.description: Build the script for a ready-made workflow.

tools.name: raidcom_model_limits
tools.description: Show valid ID and port ranges for a storage model.
